content: I want to define the quotient of Set α by a certain ideal (dual to a filter), and put a Boolean algebra structure on it. How can I do this?
I can do this by going through BoolRing, though ideally I'd rather avoid this detour.
I think the underlying issue is that we have basically no API on docs#Order.Ideal
And I feel that if I start adding it I'll inevitably open Pandora's box of "why aren't filters developed using docs#Order.PFilter"
